Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis focused on host proteins interacting with the SARS-CoV-2 Nucleocapsid protein (bait) using AP-MS in HEK293T cells. Mixed species flag is true because the bait is viral (SARS-CoV-2) and the analyzed interactors are human. PRIDE metadata mentions 'Kidney' as an organism part, but this is not supported by the INPUT_TEXT manuscript, which describes cell culture (HEK293T) for the MS experiments.
